mapper.select: SELECT a.ID as id,b.FILE_PERMISSION_CODE as filePermissionCode, c.FILE_NAME as fileName, c.USER_ID as userId , b.USER_ID as objId , IF(d.ID is not null,d.NAME,e.NAME) as objName,IF(d.ID is not null,'1','2') as objType, a.USER_FILE_ID as userFileId, c.PARENT_ID as parentId, c.FILE_PATH as filePath,c.IS_DIR as isDir, c.FILE_ID as fileId, c.ROOT_DIR as rootDir, c.ORG_ID as orgId, c.`right` as `right`, c.DATA_SCOPE_ID as dataScopeId, c.LOCK_FLAG as lockFlag, c.FOLD_TYPE as foldType, c.EXTEND_NAME as extendName, c.FILE_SIZE as fileSize, c.DELETE_BATCH_NUM as deleteBatchNum, c.DELETE_TIME as deleteTime, a.DELETE_FLAG as deleteFlag FROM PAN_COMMON_FILE a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE_PERMISSION b ON a.ID = b.COMMON_FILE_ID and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' LEFT JOIN PAN_USER_FILE c ON c.ID = a.USER_FILE_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER d ON b.USER_ID = d.ID left join SYS_ORG e on b.USER_ID = e.ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
